These are the best options for most people. Prices come from the reviews and change often, so check them before you buy.

**Best overall (fast and cool): Anker Prime MagSafe Car Mount Charger**
- It's a vent clip with Qi2 charging up to 25W.
- It has active cooling and includes a 60W adapter. It also has a two-year warranty.
- Both The Gadgeteer and MountGuys recommend it. MountGuys' author uses it daily.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at about $70 on sale ($90 list). It's the priciest pick.
- [Buy (The Gadgeteer's link)](https://pboost.me/p1SMdJ7da) or [MountGuys' link](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)

**Best value at 25W: LISEN Qi2.2 25W Car Mount with Cooling Fan**
- It's a suction-cup mount with a fan and a 95W car adapter included.
- It costs about $40.
- Its base is large. It only reaches 25W with the fan running, and 15W with the fan off.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Best budget pick with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified at 15W. It has a built-in fan and mounts on a vent or the dash.
- Code `PARTNER18` takes it from $39.99 to $32.80 at ESR's store. Dealectric tested the code on Oct 22, and it expires Dec 31, 2026. Dealectric earns a commission on that link.
- The Gadgeteer says a car adapter isn't included, so budget $10–15 for one. Its listed price for this model conflicts with ESR's, so trust the checkout price.
- [Buy with the deal](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) or [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)

**Other picks**
- **Cheapest Qi2 option:** ESR HaloLock Qi2 is about $20–27 and charges at 15W. It has no fan and no adapter. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20)
- **Works with an existing mount arm:** PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 is about $60 and charges at 15W. It has no cooling, so it may throttle in the sun. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20)
- **Dash or windshield:** iOttie Velox Mini Qi2 is about $41 and includes a car charger. Windshield mounts are restricted in some states. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20)
- **Cup holder:** EXELIQ Cup Holder Charger Mount charges at 15W. The phone sits low, so it suits charging better than navigation. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20)

**Tips**
- Hot dashboards often slow wireless charging to about 7W, so a fan is worth having if you park in the sun.
- For 25W, you need a strong USB-C PD charger, 30W or more. The Anker and LISEN fan mount include one. The LISEN vent clip doesn't.
- Some of these are affiliate links, and the reviewers may earn a commission.

If you tell me your phone model and whether you prefer a vent, dash or cup holder mount, I can narrow it to one pick.
